# MASE IDE adapter

Before changing or reviewing this project, read `project-rules.md`. It is the only maintained rule source.

MASE purpose: 让 Agentic Coding 高效交付正确、健壮、优化且易于维护的代码. Judge every trade-off by five outcomes: 高效交付、需求正确、运行健壮、质量优化、整洁可维护.

Hard minimum: confirm user-visible behavior; test before implementation; analyze impact before historical behavior changes, protect baseline tests and reconcile actual paths, call edges and side effects; keep API contracts and P0 E2E green; diagnose root causes; back up before destructive migration. For releases, bind an immutable artifact identity, verify live consumer behavior, and retain tested recovery through observation. Keep product code, data, backups, demos, and generated caches outside the MASE framework repository. Load detailed docs and Skill references only when the current Profile, risk, or task routes to them.
